aboutSubheading: Crafting Spaces You'll Love for Years
aboutText: Three Acres Landscape Architecture brings over 15 years of hands-on experience transforming outdoor spaces across Seddon and Melbourne's inner west. We specialise in creating thoughtful, sustainable landscape designs that reflect each client's unique lifestyle and the character of their neighbourhood. Our reliable team manages every phase from initial consultation through to final installation, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable process. Whether it's a complete garden overhaul or a carefully planned courtyard, we deliver exceptional results that stand the test of time.
servicesText: Our landscape architecture services encompass full design and planning, garden transformations, and outdoor living spaces tailored to Seddon's climate. We work with native and sustainable plantings while also handling hardscaping, paving, and ongoing maintenance. Every project receives our dedicated attention to detail and commitment to creating spaces that genuinely enhance how you live and enjoy your home.

testimonials.text: We wanted a low-maintenance native garden that still looked beautiful year-round, and Three Acres delivered exactly that. The planting plan is thoughtful and the result is better than we ever imagined for our Footscray home.

testimonials.text: From concept to completion, the team at Three Acres made the entire process easy and enjoyable. Our courtyard now feels like a proper extension of our living space, and we use it every single day.
